scripts.all: run () { for cmd in clean build check test; do npm run workspace -- "$cmd" || return $?; done; }; run
scripts.apps: run () { for pkg in bun cloudflare-worker node react-native web; do npm --prefix=apps/$pkg run "$@" --if-present || return $?; done; }; run "$@"
scripts.apps:install: run () { for pkg in bun cloudflare-worker node react-native web; do npm install --prefix=apps/$pkg || return $?; done; }; run
scripts.apps:test: deno task --cwd=./apps/deno test && npm run test --prefix=./apps/bun && npm run test --prefix=./apps/cloudflare-worker && npm run test --prefix=./apps/node && npm run test --prefix=./apps/react-native && npm run test --prefix=./apps/web
scripts.workspace: run () { for pkg in common codepoints dfa restructure standard-fonts unicode-trie unicode-properties upng fontkit pdf; do npm --workspace=packages/$pkg run "$@" --if-present || return $?; done; }; run "$@"
